comparison.objective: Operate a meter test switch in a safe order and insert a current test plug.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered knife-switch manipulation, constrained plug insertion, and avoidance of an unsafe circuit state.
comparison.success_condition: Required voltage and phase-A switches opened in order, plug seated and retained, forbidden switches unmoved, after-release check passed.
comparison.reason: This tests safety-critical switching order and keyed plug retention. It is not a carriage transfer across aligned continuous raceways.
